messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] detected sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate (us-east-1-gateway). 5xx rate = 18% over baseline, p95 latency = 3.2s. Paging oncall: sara, mike.

sara: I'm on it. seeing dashboard - batcher queue depth climbing on scheduler-asia-east and us-east pools. head-of-line blocking symptoms.

mike: grabbing logs now. can someone post the recent deploys?

jonas: no deploys in last 30min to gateway or batcher. looks like sudden request shape change (longer seq lengths).

nina: alerted infra-autoscaler, but autoscale hasn't kicked for batcher pods yet. maybe CPU limit preventing scale.

luis: customer ops flag: multiple customers reporting timeouts and failed requests around 11:12. support seeing 504s from gateway.

sara: steps: (1) reduce batch sizes to break head-of-line, (2) enable emergency throttling for low-priority routes, (3) add extra batcher replicas if possible.

mike: agreed. jonas, can you drop batcher.max_batch_size to 16 for affected pools?

jonas: doing it now. patch: 
```yaml
# runtime override - applied to us-east-1, asia-east-1
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 16
  max_inflight: 200
  eviction_policy: low_priority_first
```

jonas: applied config via rollout tool (rollout id r-2026-487). verifying pods pick up config...

incident-bot: rollout r-2026-487 started (target: batcher-service-us-east-1).

mike: while that's rolling, let's reduce gateway concurrency for experimental /v1/generate route to lower batching pressure. nina can you flip the route throttle?

nina: setting route throttle to 60rps (was 200rps) for /v1/generate on gateway-us-east-1. command: `gatewayctl set-rate /v1/generate 60 --region us-east-1 --reason "emergency mitigation"`

luis: FYI support posted status update to customers — letting them know we're investigating and applying mitigations.

sara: check kv-cache size — large kv entries can balloon memory and stall batching. jonas, any signs?

jonas: kv-cache growth concurrent with spike. eviction lagging because eviction thread starved due to long-running generation requests. working on prioritizing eviction.

mike: we should also enable preemptive eviction of long-lived prefixes. toggling preemptive_kv_eviction=true on runtime.

jonas: toggle applied. also restarted one offending batcher process on host batcher-13 (rolling) to clear stuck batches.

incident-bot: Deploy/Config change detected: preemptive_kv_eviction=true (applied), batcher.max_batch_size=16 (applied), route throttle set.

mike: seeing 5xx dropping from 18% -> 9% in last 2 minutes. p95 latency down to 1.8s.

nina: autoscaler now allowed to scale; spun up 3 extra batcher replicas in us-east-1.

luis: customers reporting partial recovery (timeouts reduced). support marking incident as active mitigation.

sara: keep throttle in place for 15 min, then iterative relax if stable. open timeline: incident begin 3112233500. current status: mitigations applied and recovery in progress.

mike: one lingering issue: a small subset of requests still hitting model-variant that is slower (v2-quant). routing fallback is still pointing to v2-quant for some tenants. recommend temporary fallback to v2-ff for all production tenants to stabilize.

jonas: started routing override: `runtimectl set-fallback model=v2-ff --scope=global --reason="stabilize latency"`

incident-bot: routing override scheduled (rid r-2026-488). will take ~45s to fully propagate.

mike: after override, 5xx -> 2.5%, p95 -> 0.9s. gateway 504s nearly gone. great.

sara: good. now run post-checks: validate no customer-facing errors, confirm batcher queue depth stable < 200.

nina: queue depth us-east now 150 -> steady, asia-east 120 -> steady. autoscaler healthy.

luis: support will wait another 10 min before updating customers that service is stable and full resolution upcoming.

sara: creating incident runbook ticket INC-2026-314 with timeline and mitigation steps. action items: 
- investigate root cause of sequence-length spike and why autoscaler didn't scale earlier
- add alert for kv-cache eviction lag and batcher starvation
- create emergency playbook to auto-reduce batch sizes on p95 latency > 2s

mike: logging hypothesis: traffic pattern changed (large synthetic load from few tenants) => long sequences => larger batches => head-of-line lock. follow-up: add per-tenant rate cap during bursty long-seq windows.

jonas: will collect heap/dump from batcher-13 and runtime stats for postmortem.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. next update in 10m or on change.

sara: marking oncall handoff to mike in 45m for postmortem prep. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

luis: ops-bot created INC-2026-314 and a customer communication draft.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-314 (Severity: P2). Assignees: sara, jonas, mike.

sara: closing active page. will reopen if error rate climbs. final note: keep throttle and routing override until postmortem and a safe rollback plan.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] alert cleared. 5xx rate back to baseline (<1%), latency stable."
